name: Tooltip
layerWhy: It is a phrase about one thing; it does nothing.
promise: A short description of what I am pointing at or focused on.
expectation: A dark label above the thing after a moment.
evidence: It shows on hover after half a second and at once on keyboard focus, hides on leaving and Escape, and is read as the thing's description.
context: What an icon means; a shortcut.
relationships: It adds to the thing's name; it never replaces it.
failures: Never holds the only copy of something important (no hover on a phone).

usage.markup: <button primalIconButton type="button" label="Copy Address" primalTooltip="Copy address, ⌘C">…</button>
